scope: Read-only Windows device evidence, inventory, diagnostics and safe host-side inspection.
interpretation: Software engineering readiness and coordination only. Military vocabulary is mapped to software provisioning, authorization and release readiness; no weapons, destructive actions, privileged hardware writes or autonomous deployment are authorized.
